evaluation.entry_liquidity_rule: Reject an entry session with zero or missing volume
evaluation.extreme_price_change_rule: Sensitivity excludes trades crossing a close-to-close change greater than 50% between signal and exit

limitations: The two existing production artifacts used different or unreliable historical test procedures, so superiority to them is not established by their model cards.
Candidate selection has inspected this test period; a later untouched period or forward paper run is needed before production promotion.
Returns are per trade under an assumed 40 bps round-trip cost, not portfolio returns or a live execution guarantee.
The >50% close-jump exclusion is a sensitivity check, not a verified corporate-action adjustment.
